answer: Artifact-filing bond: each new identity stakes 70 credits on a quill-signed artifact, a field survey, in a public registry, with a custody thread linking every handler. Each epoch the beacon summons 5%; auditors replay the thread and check the quill signature. A copied seal or broken thread burns the bond; the artifact falls to nadir. Filing costs 45, then 45+6(k-1): 1,000 fakes pay 3,042,000 for a 40,000 pool. An honest agent files once for 45.
